query:
INSERT INTO runtime.session_facts AS f
    (session_id, runtime, source, source_version, fidelity, completeness, observed_at, sequence,
     lifecycle, lifecycle_at, lifecycle_sequence, requested_model, requested_model_at,
     observed_model, observed_model_at, control, control_at, control_sequence,
     usage_scope, usage_basis, usage_at, usage_sequence,
     input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, total_tokens, context_window)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz, $8::bigint, $9,
        CASE WHEN $9::text IS NOT NULL THEN $7::timestamptz END, CASE WHEN $9::text IS NOT NULL THEN $8::bigint END,
        $10, CASE WHEN $10::text IS NOT NULL THEN $7::timestamptz END,
        $11, CASE WHEN $11::text IS NOT NULL THEN $7::timestamptz END,
        $12, CASE WHEN $12::text IS NOT NULL THEN $7::timestamptz END, CASE WHEN $12::text IS NOT NULL THEN $8::bigint END,
        $13, $14, CASE WHEN $14::text IS NOT NULL THEN $7::timestamptz END, CASE WHEN $14::text IS NOT NULL THEN $8::bigint END,
        $15, $16, $17, $18, $19, $20)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
    source = CASE WHEN (EXCLUDED.observed_at, EXCLUDED.sequence) >= (f.observed_at, f.sequence) THEN EXCLUDED.source ELSE f.source END,
    source_version = CASE WHEN (EXCLUDED.observed_at, EXCLUDED.sequence) >= (f.observed_at, f.sequence) THEN EXCLUDED.source_version ELSE f.source_version END,
    fidelity = CASE WHEN (EXCLUDED.observed_at, EXCLUDED.sequence) >= (f.observed_at, f.sequence) THEN EXCLUDED.fidelity ELSE f.fidelity END,
    completeness = CASE WHEN (EXCLUDED.observed_at, EXCLUDED.sequence) >= (f.observed_at, f.sequence) THEN EXCLUDED.completeness ELSE f.completeness END,
    observed_at = GREATEST(f.observed_at, EXCLUDED.observed_at),
    sequence = CASE WHEN (EXCLUDED.observed_at, EXCLUDED.sequence) >= (f.observed_at, f.sequence) THEN EXCLUDED.sequence ELSE f.sequence END,
    lifecycle = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AND (f.lifecycle_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.lifecycle_at, EXCLUDED.lifecycle_sequence) >= (f.lifecycle_at, f.lifecycle_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle ELSE f.lifecycle END,
    lifecycle_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AND (f.lifecycle_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.lifecycle_at, EXCLUDED.lifecycle_sequence) >= (f.lifecycle_at, f.lifecycle_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle_at ELSE f.lifecycle_at END,
    lifecycle_sequence = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AND (f.lifecycle_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.lifecycle_at, EXCLUDED.lifecycle_sequence) >= (f.lifecycle_at, f.lifecycle_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.lifecycle_sequence ELSE f.lifecycle_sequence END,
    control = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.control IS NOT NULL AND (f.control IS DISTINCT FROM 'managed' OR EXCLUDED.control = 'managed') AND (f.control_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.control_at, EXCLUDED.control_sequence) >= (f.control_at, f.control_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.control ELSE f.control END,
    control_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.control IS NOT NULL AND (f.control IS DISTINCT FROM 'managed' OR EXCLUDED.control = 'managed') AND (f.control_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.control_at, EXCLUDED.control_sequence) >= (f.control_at, f.control_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.control_at ELSE f.control_at END,
    control_sequence = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.control IS NOT NULL AND (f.control IS DISTINCT FROM 'managed' OR EXCLUDED.control = 'managed') AND (f.control_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.control_at, EXCLUDED.control_sequence) >= (f.control_at, f.control_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.control_sequence ELSE f.control_sequence END,
    usage_scope = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.usage_scope ELSE f.usage_scope END,
    usage_basis = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis ELSE f.usage_basis END,
    usage_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.usage_at ELSE f.usage_at END,
    usage_sequence = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.usage_sequence ELSE f.usage_sequence END,
    input_tokens = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.input_tokens ELSE f.input_tokens END,
    cached_input_tokens = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.cached_input_tokens ELSE f.cached_input_tokens END,
    output_tokens = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.output_tokens ELSE f.output_tokens END,
    reasoning_output_tokens = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.reasoning_output_tokens ELSE f.reasoning_output_tokens END,
    total_tokens = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.total_tokens ELSE f.total_tokens END,
    context_window = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.usage_basis IS NOT NULL AND (f.usage_at IS NULL OR (EXCLUDED.usage_at, EXCLUDED.usage_sequence) >= (f.usage_at, f.usage_sequence)) THEN EXCLUDED.context_window ELSE f.context_window END,
    requested_model = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.requested_model IS NOT NULL AND (f.requested_model_at IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.requested_model_at >= f.requested_model_at) THEN EXCLUDED.requested_model ELSE f.requested_model END,
    requested_model_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.requested_model IS NOT NULL AND (f.requested_model_at IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.requested_model_at >= f.requested_model_at) THEN EXCLUDED.requested_model_at ELSE f.requested_model_at END,
    observed_model = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.observed_model IS NOT NULL AND (f.observed_model_at IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.observed_model_at >= f.observed_model_at) THEN EXCLUDED.observed_model ELSE f.observed_model END,
    observed_model_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.observed_model IS NOT NULL AND (f.observed_model_at IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.observed_model_at >= f.observed_model_at) THEN EXCLUDED.observed_model_at ELSE f.observed_model_at END
WHERE f.runtime = EXCLUDED.runtime
